meetings.title: Monday standup
transcript: Maya: Nine days to FreightWorks. Pinecrest sees the live demo today at three. Quick round.
Arjun: The scoring API passed a load test at 5x. Nina takes it to 10x this week.
Nina: Ranking for Coastal's early docks looks better. The load test script is ready.
Leila: The slot picker merged Friday after Sam's review.
Sam: The demo is down to two minutes ten. The pricing page has final numbers.
Jordan: Valley's setup starts today. Coastal has twelve users on Smart Slots in staging.
Maya: Great. The booth ships Thursday, so anything printed has to be final by Wednesday.

slack.author: maya
slack.text: Nine days to FreightWorks. Pinecrest live demo at 3pm.

slack.author: jordan
slack.text: Escalation: Grace says no one at Coastal can log in since this morning. They are back on spreadsheets. Made TW-144 (assigned to Leila, it's the login page) and TW-145 for a call with Grace.

slack.author: leila
slack.text: Seeing a redirect loop after the SSO step, for Coastal accounts only.

slack.author: jordan
slack.text: Grace says their CEO is asking whether Smart Slots is ready for real use.

slack.author: sam
slack.text: Booth one-pager is final in Figma. Printing Wednesday.

slack.author: nina
slack.text: The 10x load test is scheduled for Wednesday (TW-143).

slack.author: jordan
slack.text: Valley's first week of bookings is imported.
